description: This file defines the 'Sale' class in the OpenCart e-commerce platform, specifically within the admin report extension namespace. It contains methods to retrieve various sales statistics and reports, such as total sales, orders by country/day/week/month/year, taxes, and other sales-related data.

classes.name: Sale
classes.description: Represents sales report functionality in the OpenCart admin module, extending the core model class to fetch various sales metrics.

methods.name: getTotalSales
methods.description: Calculates the total sales amount, optionally filtered by a specific date.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersByCountry
methods.description: Returns the total number of orders grouped by country, including order count and amount.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersByDay
methods.description: Provides a report of total orders by each hour of the current day.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersByWeek
methods.description: Gives a report of total orders per day over the past week, grouped by day of the week.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersByMonth
methods.description: Returns the total orders grouped by month over the current year.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersByYear
methods.description: Provides the total number of orders grouped by year.

methods.name: getOrders
methods.description: Fetches order details including start and end dates, total orders, products, tax, and total amount, with filtering options.

methods.name: getTotalOrders
methods.description: Returns the count of total orders based on grouping criteria such as day, week, month, or year.

methods.name: getTaxes
methods.description: Provides tax-related statistics from order data.

methods.name: getTotalTaxes
methods.description: Calculates total tax amount, grouped by specified time frames or categories.

methods.name: getShipping
methods.description: Fetches shipping statistics including total, date range, and order count.

methods.name: getTotalShipping
methods.description: Returns total shipping costs grouped by specified time frames.

methods.name: getTotalShipping
methods.description: Assesses total shipping costs, including filters for date and grouping.
